WHERE p.nationality <> 'German'

  AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) = 0

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE p.nationality <> 'German'
  AND CASE
        WHEN regexp_matches(p.olympic_gold_medals, '^[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)
        WHEN regexp_matches(p.olympic_gold_medals, '^at least [0-9]+$') THEN CAST(REPLACE(p.olympic_gold_medals, 'at least ', '') AS INT64)
        ELSE 0
      END > 0
  AND CASE
        WHEN regexp_matches(p.mvp_awards, '^[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64)
        ELSE 0
      END = 0
RETURN DISTINCT p.nationality AS col1, p.draft_pick AS col2, p.current_team AS col3, p.name AS name_player
